title: infra.notification_delivery.recorded.v1
description: An intent's delivery results (docs/design.md NT10), an incremental fact published once every recipient of the intent has its result: for each principal (or a position that could not be expanded in time) and channel, written, preference_off or expired for a principal; expanded, unresolvable or expired for a position. It carries no title and no link.

recipient.description: a principal, or position:<legal entity>/<position>@<date> for a position recipient (expanded: its holders have their own results)
